Fetch NJ IDEA Indicator 5C by LEA

Source: R/fetch_sped_environment.R
fetch_sped_environment.Rd

Reads NJDOE's published Local Special Education Profiles, indicator IND_5C: students with IEPs ages 5 in kindergarten through 21 served in separate schools, residential facilities, or homebound/hospital placements. This reads the published profile rate, not a sum of rounded placement percentages. Correctional facilities and parentally placed private students are not 5C component settings. The profile's published denominator is retained without substituting classification or public-IEP enrollment totals.

Usage

fetch_sped_environment(end_year)

Arguments

end_year

School year end, 2023 through 2025. 2026 is not published.

Value

A tibble, one row per LEA, indicator and year, with district_id, district_name, indicator, value_pct (0-100), value_count, n_students (the published denominator), source_value, age_group, source_file, report_year, school_year, entity_level and definition. value_count is the published numerator. A marker prevents returning either count.

Details

end_year follows SCHOOL_YEAR, not REPORT_YEAR: report 2026 has school year 2024-25 and is returned as end_year 2025. The complete NJDOE Tableau workbook and a reproducible IND_5C projection are bundled and both are verified on every call. No live fallback occurs. LOCAL is the displayed percent text; nonnumeric markers such as N remain NA with source_value unchanged. No unsuppressed hidden rate is substituted. State rows are included only where present in the source (2025 in this snapshot), with the state's own 9999 id.

Examples

fetch_sped_environment(2025)
#> # A tibble: 652 × 14
#>    end_year district_id district_name indicator value_pct value_count n_students
#>       <int> <chr>       <chr>         <chr>         <dbl>       <dbl>      <dbl>
#>  1     2025 0010        Absecon Publ… 5C             4.94           8        162
#>  2     2025 0020        Alexandria T… 5C             1.23           1         81
#>  3     2025 0030        Allamuchy To… 5C             1.49           1         67
#>  4     2025 0040        Allendale Pu… 5C            11.6           11         95
#>  5     2025 0060        Alloway Twp … 5C             6              3         50
#>  6     2025 0070        Alpha Boroug… 5C             2.78           1         36

#>  8     2025 0090        Andover Regi… 5C             3.7            3         81
